entries.input: Let $a_0 = \pi/2$ and $a_n = \sin(a_{n-1})$ for $n \geq 1$. Prove that $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n^{2}$ diverges.
entries.name: Putnam2020A3
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = Real.pi / 2) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sin (a n))
entries.title: Putnam 2020 A3
entries.witness: ⟨fun n => Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℝ) (Real.pi / 2) (fun _ x => Real.sin x) n, rfl, fun _ => rfl, trivial⟩
